## Checklist

- [ ] Unit tests added: positive **and** negative cases
- [ ] Permissions covered (allowed + denied roles, wrong tenant)
- [ ] Mobile-responsive, design tokens only (no hard-coded colors)
- [ ] Strings translated: en, de, bg
- [ ] GDPR considered (data minimal, export/erase)
- [ ] Docs / ADR updated if a decision changed
